description_en: Queries whether phone numbers support card SMS
description_zh: 查询手机号是否支持卡片短信
name: QueryMobilesCardSupport

parameters.help_en:
The code of the card SMS template. You can view the code on the China Mainland Message > Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) page in the console.

The template must be a card SMS template that has been added and approved
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。请在控制台选择国内消息>模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)页面查看。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的卡片短信模板
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method for phone numbers. Valid values:
SHA1: SHA1 encryption.
NORMAL: No encryption. Phone numbers are transmitted in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码加密方式。取值：
SHA1：SHA1加密方式。
NORMAL：不加密，明文传输
parameters.name: encrypt_type

Support.description_en:
Indicates whether card SMS is supported. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
Support.description_zh:
是否支持卡片短信。取值：

true：支持。
false：不支持
